description: Source code for various Orleans grains handling stream subscription observation, including Passive_ConsumerGrain, Jerk_ConsumerGrain, and related observer classes.

classes.name: Passive_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that subscribes to streams, counts how many times the add function is called, and maintains a list of observers and handles.

classes.name: Jerk_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that immediately unsubscribes from any stream subscription it receives.

classes.name: ICounterObserver
classes.description: Interface representing an observer with a NumConsumed property.

classes.name: CounterObserver<T>
classes.description: Implementation of IAsyncObserver and ICounterObserver that tracks the number of items consumed.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscribeGrain
classes.description: A grain derived from Passive_ConsumerGrain with implicit stream subscriptions defined by attributes.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation of the grain, initializes counters and lists.

methods.name: GetCountOfOnAddFuncCalled
methods.description: Returns how many times OnSubscribed has been called.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Calculates and logs the total number of items consumed by all observers.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes all consumer handles and clears observers and handles.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles deactivation of the grain, logging the event.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles a new stream subscription, creating an observer and subscribing to the stream.
